scope: Thunderbird work and Microsoft accounts no longer freeze Voice Companion, and End goes to the last message at once.

topics.title: Stop waiting for Thunderbird
details: If Thunderbird is slow, press Escape to stop waiting. Voice Companion tells you it stopped.
Closing Voice Companion with Alt+F4 works even while it waits for Thunderbird.

topics.title: End in a long mail folder
details: In Thunderbird mail, End now goes to the oldest message in one step.
Before, End loaded every page in turn. In a large work mailbox it never finished, and Voice Companion froze.
Page Up from the end goes back one page at a time, as before.

topics.title: New Thunderbird accounts
details: A newly added work or Microsoft account can take a while to download its mail.
Until it is done, you hear that the newest messages may not be here yet. Press F5 or say refresh messages to check again.
Work accounts that use Exchange now check for new mail too.
